strings.zh: 氫醌（Hydroquinone，對苯二酚）— 黃金標準
傳明酸（Tranexamic acid）— 外用 + 口服
麴酸、熊果素、新型 Resorcinol 衍生物
strings.en: Kojic acid, arbutin, and novel resorcinol derivatives

strings.zh: 如何搭配？早 C 晚 A 與其他組合
strings.en: How to combine? Vitamin C in the morning, retinoid at night, and other regimens

strings.zh: 孕婦 / 哺乳期能用什麼美白成分？
strings.en: Which whitening ingredients are safe in pregnancy / lactation?

strings.zh: 美白藥膏多久看到效果？
strings.en: How long until whitening creams show results?

strings.zh: 網路上「神級美白藥膏」可以買嗎？
strings.en: Should I buy the "miracle whitening creams" sold online?
Can whitening creams cause rebound darkening?

strings.zh: 口服美白藥（傳明酸 / 維他命 C / 穀胱甘肽 GSH）真的有效嗎？
strings.en: Are oral whitening agents (tranexamic acid / vitamin C / glutathione) actually effective?

strings.zh: 肝斑 vs 曬斑 vs 痘印，各用什麼成分？
strings.en: Melasma vs sunspots vs post-acne marks — which ingredient for each?

strings.zh: 研究顯示三合一比單獨使用 Hydroquinone 效果好(Taylor et al., Cutis 2003)。但「越濃越好」是錯的 — 自行配製超高濃度反而易反黑。
strings.en: Studies show triple combination outperforms hydroquinone alone (Taylor et al., Cutis 2003). But "higher concentration is better" is wrong — DIY ultra-high concentrations cause rebound hyperpigmentation.

strings.zh: 使用前需評估個人血栓風險。台灣自費約 NT$ 800-1,500/月。
strings.en: Personal thrombosis risk must be assessed before use. Out-of-pocket cost in Taiwan is approximately NT$ 800–1,500/month.

strings.zh: 新手建議從「保濕 + 防曬 + 菸鹼醯胺 + 維他命 C」開始，熟悉後加 A 醇 / A 酸 / 杜鵑花酸，最後才考慮 Hydroquinone（處方）。
strings.en: Beginners should start with moisturizer + sunscreen + niacinamide + vitamin C; once tolerated, add retinol/tretinoin or azelaic acid; consider hydroquinone (prescription) only as a final step.

strings.zh: 不可大面積使用 — 點塗於斑點即可
strings.en: Not for widespread use — apply only spot-by-spot

strings.zh: 初期可能有 1-2 週刺激，通常會適應
strings.en: 1–2 weeks of initial irritation is common, usually tolerated thereafter

strings.zh: 每天 1 次睡前薄點於斑點處
strings.en: Apply thinly once nightly to lesions

strings.zh: 有血栓病史（深部靜脈栓塞、肺栓塞、中風）
strings.en: History of thrombosis (DVT, pulmonary embolism, stroke)

strings.zh: 正在服用口服避孕藥（增加血栓風險）
strings.en: Currently using oral contraceptives (increased thrombosis risk)

strings.zh: A 酸 + 高濃度果酸 / 水楊酸（刺激倍增）
strings.en: Retinoid + high-strength AHA / salicylic acid (compounded irritation)

strings.zh: A 酸 + BPO（可能讓 A 酸氧化失效）
strings.en: Retinoid + benzoyl peroxide (may oxidize and inactivate the retinoid)

strings.zh: Hydroquinone + 高濃度果酸（刺激風險）
沒做防曬（美白成分對 UV 較敏感）
strings.en: Inadequate sun protection (whitening agents are UV-sensitive)

strings.zh: 濃度過高 / 過度使用造成發炎 → PIH
strings.en: Excessive concentration or overuse causing inflammation → PIH

strings.zh: 用錯類型 — 例如肝斑誤用全切除式雷射或極化果酸
strings.en: Wrong choice — e.g., melasma incorrectly treated with ablative laser or strong peels

strings.zh: 停藥後沒做維持治療，黑色素重新合成
strings.en: No maintenance therapy after discontinuation — melanin resynthesis resumes

strings.zh: 衛福部食藥署 — 美白成分管理規範與不法添加抽查資料。
strings.en: Taiwan FDA — whitening-ingredient regulations and illegal-adulterant inspection data.

strings.zh: 禁用成分（汞、超強類固醇）
不超過 4-6 個月連續使用
strings.en: Continuous use should not exceed 4–6 months

strings.zh: 口服 250 mg BID 或 TID
系統性回顧顯示對肝斑有顯著效果
strings.en: Systematic reviews show significant efficacy for melasma

strings.zh: 孕婦 / 哺乳期幾乎唯一的美白選項
strings.en: Essentially the only whitening option in pregnancy and lactation
Synergistic with sunscreen for antioxidant protection

strings.zh: 性價比極高的萬用成分
非「早 C 晚 A」夜晚：
杜鵑花酸 + 菸鹼醯胺 + 維他命 C + 嚴格物理防曬（含氧化鐵）
strings.en: Azelaic acid + niacinamide + vitamin C + strict mineral sunscreen (with iron oxide)

strings.zh: 違法添加汞、超強效類固醇、未登記 Hydroquinone 高濃度
strings.en: Illegal adulteration with mercury, super-potent corticosteroids, or unregistered high-concentration hydroquinone

strings.zh: 有效美白成分都是處方藥
strings.en: All effective whitening agents are prescription medications

strings.zh: 嚴格防曬 + 抑制黑色素生成成分 + 加速代謝 + 抗發炎
strings.en: Strict sun protection + melanogenesis inhibitors + turnover accelerators + anti-inflammatories

strings.zh: 8 大成分機轉、濃度、安全使用
strings.en: Mechanisms, concentrations, and safe use of 8 key ingredients

strings.zh: 網站內容更正 / 學術引用詢問 / 媒體合作請寄：
strings.en: Content corrections / academic citation inquiries / media partnerships:

strings.zh: 抑制 tyrosinase + 直接破壞黑色素細胞
肝斑、曬斑、發炎後色素沉著(PIH)、雀斑
strings.en: Melasma, solar lentigines, post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation (PIH), freckles

strings.zh: 促進角質代謝、增加 hydroquinone 穿透
strings.en: Accelerates keratinocyte turnover and enhances hydroquinone penetration

strings.zh: 抗發炎（中等強度類固醇）、減少刺激
輕中度肝斑改善，證據中等
抑制 tyrosinase + 抗發炎 + 抗菌
輕度刺激、灼熱（初期），整體溫和
抗氧化、抑制 tyrosinase、促進膠原合成

strings.en: Apply in the morning before sunscreen

strings.zh: 高濃度可能刺激；產品變黃即氧化失效
strings.en: High concentrations may irritate; yellowing indicates oxidation and loss of efficacy

strings.zh: 抑制黑色素小體傳遞 + 強化皮膚屏障 + 抗發炎
strings.en: Inhibits melanosome transfer + strengthens skin barrier + anti-inflammatory
Suitable for both morning and night use
Very gentle; suitable for sensitive skin

strings.zh: Hakozaki T et al. Br J Dermatol 2002:Niacinamide 5% vs 安慰劑,12 週後明顯改善色素
strings.en: Hakozaki T et al., Br J Dermatol 2002: Niacinamide 5% vs placebo, significant pigment improvement at 12 weeks

strings.zh: 近年熱門替代 Hydroquinone，但有特殊氣味
strings.en: Increasingly popular as a hydroquinone alternative; characteristic odor

strings.zh: 選擇性人類 tyrosinase 抑制 — 號稱比 Hydroquinone 強
strings.en: Selective human-tyrosinase inhibitor — reportedly more potent than hydroquinone

strings.zh: Eucerin Anti-Pigment 系列，科學數據不錯
strings.en: Eucerin Anti-Pigment series; reasonable scientific evidence

strings.zh: 外用 A 酸 / A 醇 / Tazarotene
